command: ../run.sh doctor --json --out /tmp/ops-chatterbox-agentic-doctor.json >/tmp/ops-chatterbox-agentic-doctor.stdout && jq -e '.schema == "ops_chatterbox.doctor_receipt.v1" and .status == "PASS_CHATTERBOX_DOCTOR" and .live == true and .mocked == false and .checks.health_ok == true and .checks.container_running == true' /tmp/ops-chatterbox-agentic-doctor.json >/dev/null && echo PASS_LIVE_CHATTERBOX_DOCTOR_READBACK
cases.name: live-doctor-receipt-readback

command:
T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ops-chatterbox-assess-good.XXXXXX)
cat > "$T/good.py" <<'PYSUB'
request = {"answer_text": clean_answer, "tts_render_text": rendered_text, "voice_delivery": policy}
response = call_chatterbox(request)
audio_ref = response.get("finished_response_audio")
audio_sha256 = sha_file(copy_audio_to_receipt_dir(audio_ref))
effects = {"affect_effect": response.get("affect_effect"), "pace_effect": response.get("pace_effect")}
PYSUB
../run.sh assess "$T/good.py" --json --out "$T/receipt.json" >/tmp/ops-chatterbox-assess-good.stdout
jq -e '.schema == "ops_chatterbox.assess_receipt.v1" and .status == "PASS_CHATTERBOX_USAGE_ASSESSMENT" and .ok == true and (.issues | length == 0)' "$T/receipt.json" >/dev/null
cp "$T/receipt.json" /tmp/ops-chatterbox-assess-good.json
echo PASS_CHATTERBOX_ASSESS_GOOD_READBACK
cases.name: usage-assessment-allows-receipt-backed-callers
cases.notes: The static assess command must allow a caller that keeps answer_text/tts_render_text separate, hashes copied audio, and records effect readbacks.

claims.does_not_prove: live Chatterbox availability, model loading, acoustic effect, ASR accuracy, or Persona Dream emotional correctness
claims.proves: the skill entrypoint emits structured receipts for health failure, usage assessment, and live-render gating

proof_scope: deterministic ops-chatterbox CLI and receipt behavior
